name: Florencio Briones
office: El Monte Union High School District, Governing Board Member, Trustee Area No. 4

items.text: Florencio Briones is the president of the El Monte Union High School District Board of Trustees, elected in 2017 and re-elected in 2022. He serves on the California School Boards Association Delegate Assembly and the Los Angeles County School Trustees Association.

sentences.text: Florencio Briones is the president of the El Monte Union High School District Board of Trustees, elected in 2017 and re-elected in 2022.
He serves on the California School Boards Association Delegate Assembly and the Los Angeles County School Trustees Association.

items.text: He says the board's role is to set policy and ensure accountability. He calls for school-by-school data, measurable attendance goals, and evidence that resources are reaching the students and families who need them most.
